description: This bar chart illustrates the "Accuracy (%)" of various model configurations evaluated on two datasets, prominently labeled "PHEME" and "PolitiFact" at the top of the image. The chart is visually divided into two side-by-side panels by a vertical dashed line. The vertical value axis represents "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale, with labeled tick marks ranging from 75.0 to 95.0 at regular intervals of 2.5, and features light gray horizontal dashed grid lines. The horizontal axis contains the categories, which are angled slightly and ordered identically within each panel: "Ours", "w/o comments" (partially obscured by a gray box in the left panel), "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition". Each category is represented by a distinctively colored bar with a thin black outline: dark red, orange, light yellow, light blue, medium blue, and dark blue, respectively. Every bar is explicitly annotated with its exact value in bold text above it. In the PHEME panel on the left, the dark red "Ours" bar reaches 89.84, followed by orange at 86.82, the shortest light yellow bar at 80.10, light blue at 88.80, medium blue at 87.34, and dark blue at 87.17. In the PolitiFact panel on the right, the dark red "Ours" bar is the tallest overall at 90.57, followed by orange at 85.85, the shortest light yellow bar at 83.02, light blue at 89.62, medium blue at 84.91, and dark blue at 87.74. The bars are grouped by dataset and follow a fixed categorical sequence rather than being sorted by numerical value or alphabetically.
